en.headline: Water supply cut overnight for seven Wong Tai Sin estates after pipe damage
en.dek: A 750 mm fresh-water main was accidentally damaged by a contractor at a Po Kong Village Road works site; the Water Supplies Department aims to restore supply by 7am Friday after emergency repairs from 11pm.
body: The Water Supplies Department said a 750-millimetre fresh-water main supplying seven housing estates in Wong Tai Sin was accidentally damaged by an electricity contractor at a pedestrian subway works site on Po Kong Village Road on Thursday.

To minimise disruption the department scheduled the emergency repair and supply interruption for after the evening peak, from 11pm, and aims to complete the work and restore normal supply by 7am on Friday unless unforeseen difficulties arise.

Temporary water points including seven water trucks and more than 60 water tanks have been arranged near the affected estates, which include Fu Shan Estate, Fung Wong Garden and several private developments; building tanks already holding stored water are expected to buffer most household demand overnight.

zh.headline: 黃大仙蒲崗村道食水管受損 七屋苑今晚11時後停水搶修
zh.dek: 直徑750毫米食水總管於行人路坑道工程地盤被電力承判商意外損壞，水務署安排今晚11時後停水緊急維修，爭取明早7時前恢復供水。
body: 水務署周四表示，黃大仙蒲崗村道一行人路坑道工程地盤內一條直徑750毫米的食水供水管，受電力工程承判商影響意外受損滲漏，該管供應宏景花園、嘉峰臺、富山邨、新麗花園、瓊山苑、瓊軒苑及帝峯豪苑。
為減低影響，署方安排在今晚11時用水高峰期後才停水進行緊急維修，除非遇上惡劣天氣或不可預知的工程困難，否則爭取在明早7時前完成並恢復食水供應。
水務署已派出7架水車及60多個水箱在受影響屋苑附近提供臨時食水，並派出供水特攻隊為長者中心及有需要居民送水；各屋苑大廈水缸已有儲水作緩衝，預計大部分用戶家中水龍頭仍可應付需要。
